description: build.modelTree: projects nest by parentID; each holds its tasks filed by category, else by group, then its dependencies, its targets and its child projects. Workspace tasks appear once beside the root projects, and one root project is merged into the instance. A filter keeps each match whole and the nodes on the way to it.
